recipes.title: Green Garlic Ginger Chicken and Rice Soup

ingredients.original: 4 cups chicken stock, broth, or bone broth
1 cup packed fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves, plus more for garnish
2 to 3 medium jalapenos, plus sliced jalapenos for garnish
1 (2-inch) piece fresh ginger, peeled and grated
1 cup cooked, pulled chicken (leftover roast or rotisserie)
2 lemons or limes, cut into wedges
kosher salt, to taste, plus 1 teaspoon for the puree

steps.text: Bring the stock to a boil. Add the spinach and cook about 1 minute until wilted. Lift it out with a slotted spoon into a blender and let it cool (never blend hot).
Return the broth to a boil, add the rice, lower the heat and simmer uncovered 10 to 15 minutes until the broth thickens and the rice starts to break apart.
Add the parsley, green garlic, whole jalapenos, garlic, ginger, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 cup water to the cooled spinach. Blend about 60 seconds until smooth, adding a splash of water if it sticks.

makeAhead.note: green puree keeps covered in the fridge

steps.text: Stir the chicken into the broth with about half the puree. Add more puree to taste, then season with salt and soy sauce.
Ladle into bowls, top with parsley and jalapeno slices, and serve with a lemon or lime wedge.

reviewNotes: Source lists no servings or times; 4 bowls, 15 min prep, 20 min cook estimated.
Ingredients say cooked rice but the method simmers it 10 to 15 minutes until it breaks apart, which reads like raw rice. Converted as cooked (the source's list); check on first cook.
Author freezes a double batch; source says fridge 4 days, freezer 6 months.
Good candidate for a leftover-chicken suggestion: cooked chicken and cooked rice in stock should surface this.
